title: “When Honor Becomes Hustle — Restoring Paul’s True Teaching on Double Honor.”
paragraphs: “When Honor Becomes Hustle — Restoring Paul’s True Teaching on Double Honor.”

Across pulpits and platforms, a single verse echoes before every offering: “Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honor.”
But what happens when honor becomes a hustle?
When a verse meant to uphold integrity becomes a slogan for manipulation?
Modern Christianity often measures “honor” with money instead of maturity — yet Paul’s teaching in 1 Timothy 5:17–18 was never written to build empires, but to guard the purity of leadership.
💭 Reader Question:
“Have we honored God’s servants — or have we turned sacred respect into a currency of control?”
📖 Main Verse — 1 Timothy 5 : 17–18 (KJV)

“Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=1+Timothy+5%3A17-18&version=KJV

💡 Essence:
Paul wasn’t demanding payment — he was defending purity.
He was reminding Timothy that leaders who labor in the Word deserve respect and support, not exploitation or neglect.
Yet he never said “double honor” equals “double pay.”
THE CORE TRUTH (Greek Breakdown + Doctrinal Restoration)
📖 1 Timothy 5 : 17–18 (KJV)

“Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=1+Timothy+5%3A17-18&version=KJV
🧠 WORD BREAKDOWN — UNLOCKING PAUL’S INTENT

1️⃣ “Elders” — Greek presbuteroi (πρεσβύτεροι):
Means mature overseers or senior ministers. Not merely pastors, but those proven in service, doctrine, and character.
💡 Insight: The term points to spiritual maturity, not positional authority. It is about responsibility, not rank.

2️⃣ “Rule well” — Greek kalōs proestōtes (καλῶς προεστῶτες):
Literally “to stand before excellently.” Refers to leaders who lead by example, not domination.
💡 Prophetic Insight: Paul honors those who shepherd by serving, not those who build empires with titles.

3️⃣ “Double honour” — Greek diplēs timēs (διπλῆς τιμῆς):
This is the heart of the controversy.
Timē means value, respect, or esteem, not automatically “money.”
It was used in Greek to describe both monetary support and moral recognition, depending on context.

💡 Contextual Truth:
In Paul’s letters, “honor” first meant esteem and care, not salary increase.
It was relational — not transactional.
Paul’s “double honor” is twofold:
Respect for their spiritual labor (honor of esteem).
Provision for their physical needs (honor of support).
Not “double pay,” but complete honor — spiritual + practical.

4️⃣ “Especially they who labour” — Greek kopiōntes (κοπιῶντες):
Means to toil to the point of exhaustion.
💡 Insight: Paul highlighted those who sacrifice rest to teach truth — not those who use the pulpit for performance.

5️⃣ “Thou shalt not muzzle the ox…”
Paul quotes Deuteronomy 25:4 to show a worker deserves sustenance — not luxury.
📖 Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Deuteronomy+25%3A4&version=KJV
💡 Meaning: Just as an ox must eat while working, a servant of God must not be starved while serving — but neither should he eat more than he labors.
💎 DOCTRINAL RESTORATION
“Double honor” does not mean “double income.”
It means holistic recognition — spiritual respect and practical support.
The Church’s error was commercializing care, turning biblical stewardship into bribery or status.

When preachers demand “double honor” as payment, they betray Paul’s intent.
True honor is not collected — it is earned through labor in the Word and purity in the walk.
📖 Cross-Reference — 1 Thessalonians 5 : 12–13 (KJV)

“And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you… and to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=1+Thessalonians+5%3A12-13&version=KJV
💡 Paul’s pattern: Love-based esteem, not guilt-based giving.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF (How the Early Church Practiced True Honor vs Abuse)
1️⃣ THE BIBLICAL MODEL — HONOR WITHOUT GREED

“I have coveted no man’s silver, or gold, or apparel. Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Acts+20%3A33-35&version=KJV

💡 Insight:
Paul, the very author of “double honor”, also worked with his own hands as a tentmaker. He demonstrated that support should bless, not burden the Body of Christ.
He never demanded offerings; he modeled stewardship.
2️⃣ JESUS’ EXAMPLE — THE SERVANT MODEL
📖 Matthew 10 : 8–10 (KJV)

“Freely ye have received, freely give. Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses…”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew+10%3A8-10&version=KJV

💡 Insight:
Christ commanded His ministers to trust in provision, not profit. He didn’t forbid support — He forbade exploitation.
The true minister depends on God through the generosity of the faithful, not manipulation of the fearful.
3️⃣ EARLY CHURCH PRACTICE — SUPPORT, NOT SALARIES
🕊 Historical Source: The Didache (Teaching of the Twelve Apostles, AD 90–120)

“Let every apostle who comes to you be received as the Lord… but if he stays three days, he is a false prophet. If he asks for money, he is a false prophet.”
Full link: https://www.earlychristianwritings.com/text/didache-lightfoot.html

💡 Insight:
Early Christians believed in hospitality, not hierarchy. Ministers were cared for, but not commercialized. The “double honor” they gave was respect and provision — not profit and power.
4️⃣ THE FIRST-CENTURY BALANCE
🕊 Ignatius of Antioch (AD 110) wrote:

“Let the presbyters be counted worthy of all honor, but let them not be lovers of money.”
Full link: https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0109.htm

💡 Insight:
The early church combined generosity with accountability. They believed the worker deserved sustenance, but greed disqualified ministry.
5️⃣ THE MODERN DISTORTION — HONOR INTO HUSTLE
In today’s pulpits, “double honor” is often weaponized:
“If you honor the man of God, you’ll receive his blessing.”
“Sow your double honor seed and unlock your miracle.”

💥 This is witchcraft wrapped in Scripture.
It replaces covenant with commerce.
Honor becomes a transaction instead of transformation.
📖 2 Peter 2 : 3 (KJV)

“And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=2+Peter+2%3A3&version=KJV
💎 Doctrinal Summary:
True double honor = Esteem + Support

False double honor = Flattery + Payment
The early church upheld the first and condemned the second.
Modern corruption has inverted the equation — making ministers kings and members customers.
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS (The Ancestry of Honor in God’s Pattern)

Paul’s teaching in 1 Timothy 5:17–18 didn’t appear out of nowhere—it was rooted in an ancient covenant rhythm where honor was sacred, never selfish.
The Old Testament reveals how honor carried prophetic weight long before it was corrupted by greed.
1️⃣ HONOR BEGAN IN THE HEART, NOT THE HAND
📖 1 Samuel 2 : 30 (KJV)

“Them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=1+Samuel+2%3A30&version=KJV

💡 Prophetic Connection:
True honor begins vertically — honoring God first. Every form of horizontal honor (to leaders, elders, parents) was meant to flow from reverence for God, not fear of man.

This destroys the false doctrine that says “honor the man of God to get blessed.”
Honor is covenant obedience, not a financial exchange.
2️⃣ HONOR THROUGH SERVICE, NOT STATUS
📖 Numbers 18 : 20–21 (KJV)

“And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land… and, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Numbers+18%3A20-21&version=KJV

💡 Prophetic Connection:
The Levites received provision for service, not luxury for status.
Their inheritance was God Himself, not gold.
Paul used this same principle — support the worker, don’t worship him.
3️⃣ THE HONOR OF WISDOM OVER WEALTH
📖 Proverbs 3 : 9 (KJV)

“Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Proverbs+3%3A9&version=KJV

💡 Prophetic Connection:
Honoring God financially was never payment, but placement.
It was to place Him above possessions.
Likewise, “double honor” is not about more money for man, but more glory to God through stewardship.
4️⃣ HONOR REQUIRES PURITY IN POSITION
📖 Malachi 2 : 1–2 (KJV)

“If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name… I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Malachi+2%3A1-2&version=KJV

💡 Prophetic Connection:
Priests were cursed not because they lacked offerings—but because they perverted honor.
God judged the ministers first for turning holy respect into corrupted rituals.
This is the same spirit Paul confronted centuries later — the commercialization of sacred ministry.
5️⃣ HONOR ALWAYS LINKED TO HUMILITY
📖 Proverbs 15 : 33 (KJV)

“The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Proverbs+15%3A33&version=KJV

💡 Prophetic Connection:
In God’s economy, humility always precedes honor.
The moment honor is demanded, it ceases to be divine.
Paul’s phrase “double honor” only applies to those who labor in humility — not those who command attention.

💎 Prophetic Summary:
The Old Testament proves that honor was a holy recognition of God’s presence in people, not a payment for their personality.
Whenever honor became financial manipulation, judgment followed.
From Eli’s sons to Malachi’s priests, God always purified the pulpit before blessing the people.
HOW THIS AFFECTS US NOW (Global Church Exposure + Call to True Honor)

1️⃣ The Age of Religious Merchandising Has Arrived
Across nations, pulpits have become platforms for profit. “Honor the prophet” has replaced “obey the Word.” Preachers measure respect by offerings, not obedience. Yet Heaven is watching.
📖 Micah 3 : 11 (KJV)

“The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Micah+3%3A11&version=KJV
💡 Prophetic Insight: God is exposing systems where ministry became marketing. The true Church must separate honor from hustle.

2️⃣ True Honor Restores Order in the House of God
When honor is biblical, it brings unity—not control.
When believers esteem elders for their labor, without idolizing them, Heaven restores balance.
📖 Romans 13 : 7 (KJV)

“Render therefore to all their dues… honour to whom honour.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Romans+13%3A7&version=KJV
💡 Prophetic Insight: The double honor Paul taught is relational order—not revenue flow. It dignifies faithful laborers and destroys the celebrity cult.

3️⃣ The Spirit of Mammon Has Infiltrated the Modern Pulpit
The devil doesn’t always silence preachers—he sponsors them.
When a man of God becomes dependent on offerings more than obedience, his altar becomes a marketplace.
📖 Matthew 6 : 24 (KJV)

“Ye cannot serve God and mammon.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew+6%3A24&version=KJV
💡 Prophetic Insight: A minister cannot carry both a cross and a price tag. The remnant must now rise to preach truth without invoice.
4️⃣ The Global Church Is Divided Between Two Doctrines of Honor
The Institutional Honor: Reward the rank, fund the image, flatter the personality.
The Kingdom Honor: Respect the labor, uphold the truth, protect the purity.

Only one is biblical.
📖 John 12 : 26 (KJV)

“If any man serve me, him will my Father honour.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=John+12%3A26&version=KJV
💡 Prophetic Insight: True honor begins when we stop exalting servants and start exalting the Master again.

5️⃣ The Church Must Return to Paul’s Pattern
Paul never used honor to manipulate; he used it to motivate holiness.
When he said “the labourer is worthy of his reward,” he was not begging for wealth but setting a standard: leaders must labor.
📖 2 Thessalonians 3 : 8 (KJV)

“Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=2+Thessalonians+3%3A8&version=KJV
💡 Prophetic Insight: The end-time ministers will walk like Paul—working if needed, but never selling truth.

💎 Global Impact Summary:
The restoration of true honor is the cleansing fire coming to the global Church.
Where money replaced ministry, God will remove lampstands.
Where honor was genuine, revival will flow.
Double honor does not mean double payment—it means complete recognition of both calling and character.
REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY (Restored Honor Without Exploitation)
Inspired by true ministry accounts across Southeast Asia during the rise of prosperity manipulation.
Testimony — “The Pastor Who Refused the Envelope”

In 2019, during a national conference in Davao, hundreds gathered to hear a respected evangelist known for healing and holiness. After his message, the host pastor, moved by gratitude, approached the stage with an envelope.
The crowd erupted — expecting the familiar moment: a public “honorarium.” But the preacher, Brother Elias, raised his hand and said softly,
“I cannot take money for something God gave me freely.”
The room went silent. He continued,
“If this is the honor I deserve, then I’d rather you honor God by feeding widows and printing Bibles.”

That night, the congregation redirected the entire offering to a missionary feeding center. Within weeks, reports spread of salvations in that region — not from a miracle crusade, but from a testimony of integrity.
Months later, a young pastor said in tears,
“That moment taught me that true honor is obedience, not an envelope.”
📖 Supporting Verse — Acts 8 : 18–20 (KJV)

“And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money… But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Acts+8%3A18-20&version=KJV

💡 Lesson:
Where honor is sold, anointing dies.
Where honor is pure, revival multiplies.
The next wave of Church reform will not come through louder preachers but through cleaner motives.

🕊 Reflection:
Honor is holy when it flows upward to God, outward to people, and downward to the poor.
When it circles only around personalities, it ceases to be honor — it becomes idolatry.
FINAL CHALLENGE (Soul-Strike Call to Return to True Honor)
📖 Anchor Verse — Romans 12 : 10 (KJV)

“Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Romans+12%3A10&version=KJV

💭 The Confrontation
The Church is facing a crossroad between humility and hype.
One road leads to Christ-like service; the other to commercial success.
Honor has become a stage performance, yet Heaven still measures it in silence, service, and sincerity.

You can give offerings and still dishonor God if your motive is manipulation.
You can give nothing and still honor Him if your heart is surrendered.
💥 Two Roads Before You
1️⃣ The Road of Carnal Honor

“I give so I can be noticed.”
“I honor to be rewarded.”
This path feeds ego while starving obedience.
2️⃣ The Road of Kingdom Honor

“I give because He gave.”
“I honor because He is worthy.”
This path breaks pride and restores purity to worship.
📖 1 Samuel 2 : 30 (KJV)

“Them that honour me I will honour.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=1+Samuel+2%3A30&version=KJV

💡 Prophetic Call:
God is removing the false altars of celebrity honor.
He is calling His people back to holy esteem—to respect leadership without worshipping it, to give without buying influence.

🕊 Reflection Challenge
Ask yourself tonight:
Do I honor God’s servants or do I idolize them?
Have I reduced gratitude to a transaction?
If my pastor had nothing to offer me, would I still serve faithfully?
📖 Matthew 10 : 42 (KJV)

“Whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple… shall in no wise lose his reward.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew+10%3A42&version=KJV

💎 Final Appeal:
True honor has a voice that says:

“I give, not to impress, but to express love.”
When this voice returns to the Church, revival will no longer be for sale—it will be released.
🕊 Prayer of Holy Honor

“Lord Jesus, purify my motives.
Deliver me from religious show and self-seeking generosity.
Teach me to honor with truth, to give without strings, to respect without idolatry.
Let my heart honor You first, then all who labor faithfully in Your Word.
May my giving become worship, and my worship remain pure.
In Your name I reclaim double honor as You intended—respect and righteousness together. Amen.”
FOOL’S RESPONSE VS WISE RESPONSE
📖 Anchor Verse — Proverbs 26 : 12 (KJV)

“Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Proverbs+26%3A12&version=KJV
⚠️ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE

❌ “Double honor means I deserve double pay.”
❌ “The more I give to the preacher, the more favor I get.”
❌ “If I stop sowing into my leader, I’ll lose my blessing.”
❌ “God’s favor can be bought with offerings.”

💥 Result:
The fool turns Scripture into superstition.
They worship men instead of honoring God.
They give to impress, not to impact.
Their generosity is loud, but their heart is bankrupt.
📖 Matthew 6 : 2 (KJV)

“When thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do… that they may have glory of men.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew+6%3A2&version=KJV
💡 Revelation: The fool gives publicly and loses privately.
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE

✔ “I honor God by honoring His truth, not buying His favor.”
✔ “I support true laborers without turning them into idols.”
✔ “I will not let manipulation dictate my generosity.”
✔ “I give in secret; God rewards in glory.”

🔥 Result:
The wise believer sees giving as worship, not wages.
They discern between honor and hustle.
They give through conviction, not compulsion.
📖 2 Corinthians 9 : 7 (KJV)

“Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=2+Corinthians+9%3A7&version=KJV
💡 Revelation: The wise don’t give to get—they give because they’ve already received.
🕊 Reflection Prayer

“Lord, keep me from the pride of the fool and the blindness of greed.
Let me never trade truth for trend.
Teach me to honor leaders through service, generosity, and love—never through manipulation.
May every seed I sow be pure, guided by Your Spirit alone. Amen.”
WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? (Judgment Confrontation)
📖 Anchor Verse — Hebrews 9 : 27 (KJV)

“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Hebrews+9%3A27&version=KJV
💭 The Confrontation

If you died tonight…
Would your giving testify of worship—or of manipulation?
Would Heaven record your “honor” as gratitude to God—or payment for favor?

When you stand before the Lord, your envelopes, titles, and offerings will not speak for you—your motives will.
He will not ask, “How much did you give?”
He will ask, “Why did you give?”
📖 Matthew 6 : 21 (KJV)

“For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew+6%3A21&version=KJV

💡 Reflection:
If money became your measure of faith, then your altar became your idol.
True honor begins where self-interest dies.
If your heart gave to be seen by men, your reward was already received—in applause, not eternity.
📖 Revelation 22 : 12 (KJV)

“And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Revelation+22%3A12&version=KJV

💥 Prophetic Insight:
On Judgment Day, the same Jesus who overturned the money changers’ tables will overturn every system that sold His Word.

You cannot bribe the Judge of Heaven.
You can only bow before Him.
🕊 Prayer of Eternal Reflection

“Lord Jesus, if I died tonight, may my record show that I honored You, not men.
Strip my motives of greed, guilt, or gain.
May every offering I gave be found holy, every act of giving born from love.
When I see You face to face, let my worship—not my wealth—be my witness. Amen.”
SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS (How the Enemy Twists “Honor” into Corruption)
📖 Anchor Verse — 2 Corinthians 2 : 11 (KJV)

“Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=2+Corinthians+2%3A11&version=KJV
👿 Deception #1 — “If you honor the man of God, you’ll get his anointing.”

This lie turns impartation into transaction.
It reduces the Holy Spirit’s power to something bought instead of received by faith.
💥 Truth:
📖 Acts 8 : 18–20 (KJV)

“Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Acts+8%3A18-20&version=KJV
No seed can buy what only surrender can birth.
👿 Deception #2 — “Your seed proves your honor.”

The devil replaces obedience with offerings. Many are guilt-tripped into giving, not guided by the Spirit.
💥 Truth:
📖 1 Samuel 15 : 22 (KJV)

“Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=1+Samuel+15%3A22&version=KJV
True honor is obedience, not overgiving.
👿 Deception #3 — “If you stop giving, you stop being blessed.”

This lie enslaves believers with fear instead of freeing them with faith.
💥 Truth:
📖 Philippians 4 : 19 (KJV)

“But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Philippians+4%3A19&version=KJV
Your blessing comes from Christ, not the charisma of a preacher.
👿 Deception #4 — “Honor must always be public.”

Satan inflates egos by making generosity a spectacle. Many leaders demand visible adoration to feed pride.
💥 Truth:
📖 Matthew 6 : 4 (KJV)

“That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew+6%3A4&version=KJV
Hidden honor carries Heaven’s weight; public flattery fades fast.
👿 Deception #5 — “To honor means to never question.”

The enemy confuses loyalty with blindness. Many fear confronting error because they mistake silence for submission.
💥 Truth:
📖 Galatians 2 : 11 (KJV)

“But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Galatians+2%3A11&version=KJV
True honor confronts error in love—it does not enable it.

💎 Counter Strategy — The Armor of True Honor:
1️⃣ Discernment: Test every voice by Scripture.
2️⃣ Integrity: Give from faith, not flattery.
3️⃣ Accountability: Honor without losing your voice.
When the Church learns these three, the false prophets lose their paycheck.
GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION (Public Surrender & Restoration of True Honor)
📖 Anchor Verse — Proverbs 3 : 9 (KJV)

“Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Proverbs+3%3A9&version=KJV
✝️ DECLARATION OF PURE HONOR

“Lord Jesus Christ, I renounce every false system of manipulation that disguised itself as honor.
I refuse to trade worship for wealth, or truth for trend.
I will honor Your servants in humility, not in idolatry.
I will give by conviction, not coercion.
I will love Your ministers without turning them into masters.
My giving will be holy, my heart will be hidden, and my worship will be without price.
Let double honor return to its original design—respect in truth and support in purity.
I honor You first, and through You, I honor those who labor faithfully in Your Word.
In Your name, I restore true honor to Your Church. Amen.”

📢 Public Stand Challenge:
Declare publicly or post:
“Honor is not for sale — it belongs to God alone.”
Then act this week:
Privately bless a faithful servant of God without announcing it.
Refuse to participate in any offering built on manipulation.
Study 1 Timothy 5:17–18 in context and teach it to another believer.
📖 Encouragement Verse — John 12 : 26 (KJV)

“If any man serve me, him will my Father honour.”
Full link: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=John+12%3A26&version=KJV
💎 Truth: The highest honor isn’t given by men — it’s given by the Father Himself.
